summary: Scoped review of the added order issue-history rules and delivery confirmation callables: server-only writes, parent-order ownership and trusted profile roles were retained. This score applies only to these changes, not to all deployed Firebase rules or production readiness. Emulator regressions cover unauthorized reads/writes, actor ownership, sequential confirmation and open-issue blocking.

checks.update_bypass: Client create/update/delete of orders and issue records are denied; Admin SDK callables validate transitions.
checks.authority_source: Authenticated UID and existing users document roles are used, not caller-provided role/owner fields. Existing immutable-role rules remain.
checks.business_logic: Only assigned rider delivers; only owner confirms after delivery; open support pauses both actions; staff response does not complete an order.
checks.resource_limits: Issue reasons/comments/responses are bounded; at most ten new reports per order; listRiders returns at most 100 safe records per cursor page.
checks.type_safety: Callable input validators check IDs and strings; client issue writes are denied. Legacy timestamps are not synthesized.
checks.identity_access: Issue reads require customer ownership, staff role, or assigned rider identity using the parent order; unrelated authenticated users cannot read them. listRiders is admin-only and returns UID/name only.
